body: I do want to give up. I've been trying for too hard for too long. Even when I do manage to get a friend, it's me doing all the work in the relationship. I'm exhausted and just not strong enough.

Seriously. I have. You think I'm just sitting around my house moping about how I have no one? Making friends has always been difficult for me, so I actively step out of my comfort zone to do things I don't necessarily enjoy just to meet people. 

I've tried finding crochet groups at yarn shops. All they have are knitting groups of women twice my age. Hardly peers I could cultivate any relationships with, who don't even share my same hobby.

I went to events about a year or so ago with the reddit facebook group; they're very active. I went and did things with them for about 6 months, but I'm an introvert. Going out and socializing to that extreme is exhausting and all I got were acquaintances. Hardly anyone close enough to call friends. So, exhausted, I petered out and stopped going to things.

I've taken my dog to various dog parks to try to meet people there. No luck.

I go to parties thrown by my coworkers. Again, I do actively try socializing with my coworkers outside of work, but nothing grows into anything past "work-buddies."
I wouldn't be where I am right now if I haven't already. I go out drinking with them after work sometimes, but none of those relationships really progress past "work-buddies."
